hero.subtitle: Orthopaedics and Traumatology — Shoulder and Elbow Surgery, Istanbul

about.title: Every patient is at the heart of their own story.
about.text: I am a specialist in Orthopaedics and Traumatology with a particular focus on shoulder and elbow surgery, sports injuries and arthroscopic surgery. Wherever clinically appropriate, I favour minimally invasive arthroscopic techniques to shorten recovery, and I closely follow current developments in biological treatment modalities. Since 2018, I have also served as head coach of the Istanbul Medical Chamber basketball team.

expertise.title: Surgical fields of focus
expertise.lead: Each case is assessed on its own merits; a treatment plan is developed together with the patient and carried through diagnosis, surgery and the entire recovery process.

items.title: Shoulder Surgery and Arthroscopy
items.text: Arthroscopic (minimally invasive) techniques for shoulder instability, rotator cuff tears and impingement syndromes.

items.title: Elbow Surgery
items.text: Advanced surgical expertise in elbow fracture-dislocations, instability and reconstruction following complex trauma.

items.title: Sports Injuries
items.text: Arthroscopic repair of anterior cruciate ligament (ACL) and meniscal tears, enabling athletes to return safely to play.

items.title: Knee and Hip Arthroplasty
items.text: Joint replacement surgery for advanced osteoarthritis, as well as complex revision procedures.

items.title: Fracture and Trauma Surgery
items.text: Contemporary treatment of long-bone fractures using intramedullary nailing and plate-and-screw fixation.

items.title: Foot and Ankle Surgery
items.text: Surgical treatment of foot and ankle conditions, notably hallux valgus correction and Achilles tendon repair.

approach.title: A transparent, calm and patient-centred process
approach.lead: A decision for surgery often marks an anxious period in a patient's life. To make this process as clear and predictable as possible, I prioritise open communication at every stage.

steps.title: Assessment
steps.text: At the initial consultation, your symptoms and imaging studies (MRI/X-ray) are reviewed together, and time is set aside for your questions.

steps.title: Treatment Plan
steps.text: Whether conservative management or surgery is indicated is clarified, and alternative options are explained openly.

steps.title: Surgery
steps.text: Minimally invasive arthroscopic techniques are preferred wherever possible in order to shorten recovery time.

steps.title: Rehabilitation
steps.text: A structured process supported by physiotherapy and follow-up visits aims for a safe return to daily life and sport.

testimonials.title: Highlights from patient reviews
testimonials.lead: The themes below summarise recurring points in patient reviews shared on online appointment platforms; they are not verbatim quotations.

themes.title: Thorough Information
themes.text: The most frequently highlighted point in patient reviews is the detailed information provided about the preoperative process and treatment alternatives.

themes.title: Close Postoperative Follow-up
themes.text: The care and accessibility shown during follow-up appointments is another point that patients frequently emphasise.

themes.title: Minimally Invasive Approach
themes.text: Reviews include positive feedback on how arthroscopic techniques shorten the recovery period.

themes.title: Guidance Throughout Rehabilitation
themes.text: Patients with sports injuries in particular value the guidance provided during their return to sport and daily life.
